states.digest_assertion: every control state digest asserted against logs/sgwriter1/qual.jsonl before it is read (sg_failure_desk.load_state)

probe_split.note: chunk 7 = 4,330 of 9,150 HELDOUT tokens and longer than every FIT sequence; per-chunk ratio receipted beside the pooled one

predictor.input: Z_j = [x_{l+1,j} (384), e_j (40)] at every real token j; FIT-standardized per feature, clipped to [-5, 5]; nothing else
predictor.target: Y_i = delta^BP_{l,i} / s_l at eligible positions (labels != -100), sealed arena constants, parameter-detached teacher pass at the snapshot W

arch.position: fixed ALiBi slopes 2^-2, 2^-4, 2^-6, 2^-8 on |j - i|; no absolute position table

arms.reverse_causal: query i reads key j iff j >= i and real(j) (PRIMARY)
arms.local: query i reads key j == i only (same-position ablation, same everything else)

fit.batch: one padded FIT chunk per step, fixed order 0,2,4,6
fit.loss: elementwise MSE over eligible positions x hidden dims (FOLD B)
fit.stopping_rule: fixed budget; readout = FINAL state; 25-epoch HELDOUT curve for the record only, selects nothing; nonfinite loss stops the fit and marks the cell nonfinite

readouts: held_ratio = sum ||Y - G||^2 / sum ||Y||^2 over HELDOUT eligible tokens

bars.text: median over late_steps x blocks of reverse_causal held_ratio <= 0.5 FIRES
bars.fires: bank SEQUENCE-SG qualification design (reverse-causal sequence predictor as online writer, seed 28) for a SEPARATE Artin GO; no birth here
bars.no_fire: SG family closes at this arena (same-position and reverse-causal cross-position inputs of the per-block sequence both fail on the healthy control's trained states within the registered capacity)

descriptive: local late median and per-cell gap reverse_causal - local
refuted_if: BAR-1 no-fire refutes the information-hole hypothesis at this capacity and budget only; larger predictors, bidirectional input, or downstream weights as input are separate pre-regs
fences: one seed (27), one device (Mac CPU), float32 fits on fp64 targets
